originalTitle: Baylen Out Loud: The Wedding | Official Trailer (TLC 2026)
content: Baylen Dupree and Colin Dooley's big day plays out across two episodes, closing out season 3 of TLC's 'Baylen Out Loud.' Part 1 airs Tuesday, Aug. 18, at 9 p.m. ET/PT, followed by part 2 on Wednesday, Aug. 25, at 10 p.m. ET/PT. Both episodes will be available to stream on HBO Max the day after they premiere on TLC.
